72	const countBy = <T>(items: T[], keyOf: (item: T) => string): Map<string, number> => {
73	  const counts = new Map<string, number>();
74	  for (const item of items) {
75	    const key = keyOf(item);
76	    counts.set(key, (counts.get(key) ?? 0) + 1);
77	  }
78	  return counts;
79	};
80	
81	const countItemsByType = (items: QuoteItem[]): Map<string, number> =>
82	  countBy(items, (item) => item.type);
83	
84	const sumBy = <T>(items: Iterable<T>, valueOf: (item: T) => number): number => {
85	  let total = 0;
86	  for (const item of items) {
87	    total += valueOf(item);
88	  }
89	  return total;
90	};
91	
92	const basePremiumForType = (type: string): number => {
93	  const basePremium = ITEM_BASE_PREMIUMS[type];
94	  if (basePremium === undefined) {
95	    throw new Error(`Unknown item type: ${type}`);
96	  }
97	  return basePremium;
98	};
99	
100	const premiumForAlikeGroup = (type: string, count: number): number => {
101	  const basePremium = basePremiumForType(type);
102	  const formsExactlyOneBlock = count === ALIKE_BLOCK_SIZE;
103	  return formsExactlyOneBlock ? ALIKE_BLOCK_PREMIUM : count * basePremium;
104	};
105	
106	const calculatePolicyBasePremium = (items: QuoteItem[]): number =>
107	  sumBy(countItemsByType(items), ([type, count]) =>
108	    premiumForAlikeGroup(type, count),
109	  );
110	
111	const itemSurcharge = (
112	  items: QuoteItem[],
113	  applies: (item: QuoteItem) => boolean,
114	  rate: number,
115	): number =>
116	  sumBy(items, (item) =>
117	    applies(item) ? basePremiumForType(item.type) * rate : 0,
118	  );
119	
120	const calculateCurseSurcharge = (items: QuoteItem[]): number =>
121	  itemSurcharge(items, (item) => item.cursed === true, CURSE_SURCHARGE_RATE);
122	
123	const calculateHighEnchantmentSurcharge = (items: QuoteItem[]): number =>
124	  itemSurcharge(
125	    items,
126	    (item) => (item.enchantment ?? 0) >= HIGH_ENCHANTMENT_THRESHOLD,
127	    HIGH_ENCHANTMENT_SURCHARGE_RATE,
128	  );
129	
130	const calculateQuotePremium = (
131	  items: QuoteItem[],
132	  customer: Customer,
133	  isFollowUpContract: boolean,
134	): number => {
135	  const policyBasePremium = calculatePolicyBasePremium(items);
136	  const curseSurcharge = calculateCurseSurcharge(items);
137	  const highEnchantmentSurcharge = calculateHighEnchantmentSurcharge(items);
138	  const firstInsuranceSurcharge = policyBasePremium * FIRST_INSURANCE_RATE;
139	  const loyaltyDiscount =
140	    customer.yearsWithMHPCO >= LOYALTY_YEARS_THRESHOLD
141	      ? policyBasePremium * LOYALTY_DISCOUNT_RATE
142	      : 0;
143	  const followUpDiscount = isFollowUpContract
144	    ? policyBasePremium * FOLLOW_UP_DISCOUNT_RATE
145	    : 0;
146	  return Math.ceil(
147	    policyBasePremium +
148	      curseSurcharge +
149	      highEnchantmentSurcharge +
150	      firstInsuranceSurcharge -
151	      loyaltyDiscount -
152	      followUpDiscount +
153	      PROCESSING_FEE,
154	  );
155	};
156	
157	const ITEM_INSURANCE_VALUES: Record<string, number> = {
158	  sword: 1000,
159	  amulet: 600,
160	  rune: 250,
161	};
162	const DEDUCTIBLE = 100;
163	const PAYOUT_CAP_MULTIPLIER = 2;
164	// Claim-side threshold — a separate business rule from the premium-side
165	// HIGH_ENCHANTMENT_THRESHOLD (5); do not merge them.
166	const CLAIM_HIGH_ENCHANTMENT_THRESHOLD = 8;
167	const HIGH_ENCHANTMENT_REIMBURSEMENT_RATE = 0.5;
168	
169	const calculateInsuranceSum = (items: QuoteItem[]): number =>
170	  sumBy(items, (item) => ITEM_INSURANCE_VALUES[item.type]);
171	
172	const initialPayoutCap = (policy: QuoteStep): number =>
173	  calculateInsuranceSum(policy.items) * PAYOUT_CAP_MULTIPLIER;
174	
175	const reimbursementForDamage = (
176	  damage: Damage,
177	  insuredItems: QuoteItem[],
178	): number => {
179	  if (damage.amount < 0) {
180	    throw new Error(`Negative damage amount: ${damage.amount}`);
181	  }
182	  const damagedItem = insuredItems.find(
183	    (item) => item.type === damage.itemType,
184	  );
185	  if (damagedItem === undefined) {
186	    throw new Error(`Damaged item not covered by policy: ${damage.itemType}`);
187	  }
188	  const hasHighEnchantment =
189	    (damagedItem.enchantment ?? 0) >= CLAIM_HIGH_ENCHANTMENT_THRESHOLD;
190	  const reimbursedAmount = hasHighEnchantment
191	    ? damage.amount * HIGH_ENCHANTMENT_REIMBURSEMENT_RATE
192	    : damage.amount;
193	  return reimbursedAmount - DEDUCTIBLE;
194	};
195	
196	const assertDamagesCoveredByPolicy = (
197	  damages: Damage[],
198	  insuredItems: QuoteItem[],
199	): void => {
200	  const insuredCounts = countItemsByType(insuredItems);
201	  const damageCounts = countBy(damages, (damage) => damage.itemType);
202	  for (const [type, damageCount] of damageCounts) {
203	    if (damageCount > (insuredCounts.get(type) ?? 0)) {
204	      throw new Error(`More damages than insured items of type: ${type}`);
205	    }
206	  }
207	};
208	
209	const processClaim = (
210	  claimStep: ClaimStep,
211	  policy: QuoteStep,
212	  remainingCapBefore: number,
213	): ClaimResult => {
214	  assertDamagesCoveredByPolicy(claimStep.incident.damages, policy.items);
215	  const totalReimbursed = sumBy(claimStep.incident.damages, (damage) =>
216	    reimbursementForDamage(damage, policy.items),
217	  );
218	  const payout = Math.min(Math.floor(totalReimbursed), remainingCapBefore);
219	  return { payout, remainingCap: remainingCapBefore - payout };
220	};
221	
222	export const runScenario = (scenario: Scenario): ScenarioResult => {
223	  const remainingCaps = new Map<number, number>();
224	  const results = scenario.steps.map((step, index): StepResult => {
225	    if (step.op === "claim") {
226	      const policy = scenario.steps[step.policy] as QuoteStep;
227	      const remainingCapBefore =
228	        remainingCaps.get(step.policy) ?? initialPayoutCap(policy);
229	      const result = processClaim(step, policy, remainingCapBefore);
230	      remainingCaps.set(step.policy, result.remainingCap);
231	      return result;
232	    }
233	    const isFollowUpContract = index > 0;
234	    return {
235	      premium: calculateQuotePremium(
236	        step.items,
237	        scenario.customer,
238	        isFollowUpContract,
239	      ),
240	    };
241	  });
242	  return { results };
243	};
</system-reminder>

content.text:
The MHPCO Claim Office kata is complete: all 36 tests pass, the CLI works end-to-end, and `experiment-done.txt` is written.

**How it went, in summary:**

- **Test List phase** (skill): 36 `it.todo()` tests derived from every rule, example, and ❓ clarification in `prompt.md`, ordered simple → complex (base premiums → component blocks → modifiers → claims → cap tracking → CLI error cases).
- **Red/Green cycles** (skills, main context): 25 tests went through full Red→Green cycles; 11 passed immediately upon activation (each predicted correctly beforehand — mostly boundary cases like enchantment 4 vs 5, and the dragon-material clause, which coincides with default full reimbursement except where the 50% rule wins). Every failure prediction in the Red phases matched the actual error.
- **Refactor phases** (isolated `refactor` subagents): 16 subagent runs, each keeping tests green. Notable outcomes: all magic numbers became named domain constants (`CURSE_SURCHARGE_RATE`, `CLAIM_HIGH_ENCHANTMENT_THRESHOLD` documented as distinct from the premium-side threshold), shared helpers extracted where duplication genuinely emerged (`itemSurcharge`, `countBy`, `sumBy`, `basePremiumForType`), and the hand-rolled stdin reader replaced by `node:stream/consumers`' `text` (APP mass −20).

**Final deliverables:**
- `src/claim-office.ts` — core logic: quote premiums (per-item surcharges on item base, policy-wide modifiers as additive percentages of the policy base, ceil at the end), claims (per-entry deductible, 50%-enchantment clause, per-policy cap tracking across successive claims, floor at the end), and validation errors.
- `src/cli.ts` — reads a scenario from stdin, writes `{results}` to stdout, maps errors to stderr with exit code 1.
- `src/claim-office.spec.ts` — 36 passing tests covering every spec example, including both integration examples (165 G and 160 G premiums) and all four CLI error cases.
